title: World Bank says ‘small AI’ could transform developing countries
hook_text: World Bank turns to small AI
script:
The World Bank says small AI models could transform developing countries.
Lesser resource systems offer a practical path for emerging economies.
Developing regions face high barriers when adopting massive frontier models.
Lightweight architectures lower infrastructure costs and reduce hardware dependencies.
Local deployment helps governments tackle agriculture and public health challenges.
Affordable localized tools let rural communities run customized workloads on standard devices.
Would smaller systems bridge the global technology gap faster?
